text: I'm explaining this to my team later. Make all the shapes an indigo ellipse. Make the ellipses a large black diamond. That's because the old one was wrong. Line up Bathroom, Closet and Pantry in a column, and after that clear dots.
Let me see. Raise every fuchsia hexagon, and drag the gold diamonds downwards. Next, move the oldest oval down.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Undo that first. After that, wire Battery to Led and Coil. What rules are there? Push the last dot right side of Vcc.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Relocate the teal hexagons left side of the first blue star. Stick a teal star, and then link the star to Done. Almost done.
Link Noah, Olivia and Grandma each to the next one, and then line up the orange hexagons horizontally.
Show me the connections? Throw a navy star with the label "Draft" next to Hr, and make the latest one indigo. How many diamonds do we have?
Wire Coral and Shark to Heron. After that, rename the Plankton to Opal!
Which one is smallest? Relocate Venus on the left of Mercury, and sketch an orange star in the center. Show all indigo stars in the bottom right corner?
Spawn a tiny pink rectangle labeled 'OK'. That's the main flow. Write "retry" on the pink block.
Draw a wire from Branding to Goals. After that, duplicate Risks. Just tidying things up a bit. Sever the link from Idea to Timeline. Thanks!
Clear the canvas, sketch a huge magenta rect, then copy the magenta box 2 times, and add the text "loop" to the square.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Is the most recent square navy? Make the same one bigger. Next, attach Launch and Idea to Scope, and connect Scope, Team and Idea every pair.
Does the diagram have any cycles? Wipe the purple ones! Nice.
Kill the squares. Then make a giant violet block with the name Karma to the lower left corner.
Tie Marketing to Sales, Sales to Finance! Where can I go from Legal?
My manager asked for this. Wire Led and C2. Next, align each triangle horizontally. Almost done.
Move Users along the left edge. Are there any triangles that are not gray?
Backlog at the top, please. Sorry, long day. Hook Sprint2, Story and Todo in a chain. What's closest to Testing?
Change the color of the fuchsia items to blue, and place a black hexagon over Lan. Is the black hexagon white? Grow it! Thanks!
Show me the connections? Dupe the triangle 5 times.
Slide the newest green hexagon on top of the earliest turquoise triangle, and then rename the orange diamond to Cedar. Summarise the drawing? Redo!
Trash diamonds. How many nodes are on the canvas? What's the nearest shape to the most recent triangle?
Colour all the shapes red, and hook Closed, Running and Error to each other with an arrow. Almost done.
Hmm, let me think. Count the links? Erase the whole diagram. After that, resize Supplier.

Wire Attic, Studio and Kitchen every pair. What are the neighbors of the indigo rectangle? Link the star to Pantry with an arrow. Slap an ellipse called Ursa between Bedroom and Studio. Then send Ursa to the back. Thanks.
Rename Branding to Indigo2. Also, hook Goals and Branding to Research. Almost done.
List all arrows? Undo the last change!
Space Studio, Office and Attic out vertical evenly, and place the Bathroom between Studio and Porch.
Set Relay to green. Then rename that one to Dune. Sorry, long day. Create five little brown hexagons labeled Next on the right. After that, drag them in the top right.
Turn Rb into a white star. What color is it? What's written on the triangle?
What's the location of the oldest block? Is that one brown? What is the farthest purple star from Api?
Can the newest oval reach Locked? Tuck the last golden rect left by 250px. Sorry, long day. Bring this one to the front! What color is it?
Locked points to Idle. Clear everything and send Closed backwards. Next, organise every scarlet dot in a stack. How many white diamonds on the right side?
What does the rect link to? How many arrows are there? Banish the amber squares. Also, reposition all blue ovals upwards by 200.
Make a copy of Krill! New hexagons must be golden! What color is the star? Move it under Heron!
Which node is the largest triangle? Exchange Export with Monitor, and make all the nodes that are not gold a red star.

Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Blocks should be big from now on. How large is the rhombus? Pop a minuscule brown block. Just tidying things up a bit. Shove the yellow dots to the left by 15 units!
Describe the latest gray triangle? Trash the turquoise squares. This is for the meeting. Make the teal boxes tiny.
Reposition Kafka, Pod2 and Api between Bucket and Redis, and then pop a triangle! Lambda is large. What color is that one?
Line up all navy hexagons in a column. Also, color the last magenta circle blue! What color is this one?
Change the shape of the scarlet ones to an ellipse. I keep losing track of things. Create a diamond that says "Pending". That's because the old one was wrong. Paint it violet.
Connect Warehouse, Customs and Supplier to the next one! How many connections are there?
Done is a hexagon. Ugh, messy. Make that one bigger!
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Morph all the pink ones into a star. How many links has Parse got? Call Validate Cedar!
We are planning the next sprint. Lan is in the top left. New triangles must be crimson. Slide the white circle between Ap2 and Dhcp. Next, send the same one to the back, and send it to the back.
We are planning the next sprint. Tie Avatar to Navbar and Button1 with a dotted undirected arrow, and move Footer to the left.

My manager asked for this. Put 9 stars “Q1” between Deploy and Clean, then align them horizontally. Just tidying things up a bit. Layout vertically, and add an orange diamond called Grove in the top right corner.
My manager asked for this. Rename the orange star as Sage. That's the main flow. Change Waiting to big. Then rename Loading as Dune.

Let me see. Make a dotted lilac line from Forest to Mine, and after that tie Forest, Cave, Temple and Volcano each to the next. Then distribute Village and Temple evenly vertical. This is for the meeting. Ditch every square that is not indigo! Bridge is blue.
Is Capacitor navy? Clone it 2 times!
Is there a rhombus? Put Sprint1 and Blocked under Backlog.
Delete everything. That's the main flow. Take it back. After that, pop one massive black ball. Also, bring the newest one to the front! List the triangles?
Draw four cyan boxes, and after that arrange them as a column. Then bring Testing forward, and after that write "TODO" on the same one! Almost done.
This is for tomorrow's review. Make every blue circle a lot smaller. Is there a way to go from the navy star to Factory? Send Retailer to back.
Plonk a white square with the name Koala between Archive and Etl! It was getting crowded. What can I reach from Validate?
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Turn the amber ones into an oval, and after that remove all diamonds which are not brown! Is Retry reachable from Begin? Rename the newest diamond to Beacon.
Hook Sprint1 and Epic, and after that nudge Deployed and Blocked on the bottom. Is Testing bigger than Deployed? Clone it 3 times. Next, label Story as "Draft".
Bring Fish to the front. After that, clone it 2 times.
Park the newest oval on the right of Yeast. Then place a gold hexagon with the name Yarrow, and then color Yarrow aqua. Next, make that one bigger, and then inscribe "beta" on it. Thanks!
Line up Venus, Mercury and Sun horizontal. Is Jupiter between Moon and Neptune? Connect it to Neptune. That's the main flow. Make each navy rhombus much bigger! List all objects?
Turn the hexagon into a minuscule indigo hexagon! How large is the cyan oval? Send the same one to the back!
List the defaults? Grow every square a bit!
What is the label of the silver triangle? Send that one to the back. Right, that's better. Overview of the diagram? Nudge the oldest lime triangle beneath Backlog. Nice.
Join Process to Check and Check to Retry. Then park the last rhombus between Verify and Stop2!
I'm drawing the family tree for grandma. Lay out the yellow stars in a column. Next, transform the items that are not black into a dot, unlink Supplier from Store.
Ok so I'm sketching our office network. Shift the lilac hexagon in the lower right, then write "Input" on that one. Send the same one to the back, and then rename it to Umbra.
What is reachable from the last brown rhombus? Clear black rects.
Reset the teal ones. After that, turn triangles gray!
Swap the positions of Studio and Pantry. After that, title Bathroom "end". Then rename it to Plume and label the oval "sync"!
Undo that. This is for the meeting. Rename the oldest triangle Aster. Next, delete the wire from Header to Avatar.
Create a lime link from Temple to Mine. How many lines are there? Make all shapes green.
Launch is gold. Make circles big, and create a dashed pink link from Timeline to Pricing. How many lines are there?
Hmm, let me think. Turn every oval that is not cyan blue. Next, connect Button1 with Menu. Ugh, messy. Convert all the lime ones into a star.
Trade Sensor and the amber rect, and then caption all of the white squares "upload". After that, write "Input" on all the navy circles.
My manager asked for this. Re-apply. How many aqua balls are there? Any black stars? Line up the black squares vertically, and then turn the pink triangles massive!
Build an amber regular circle on the right of Blocked. Backlog is between Testing and Ticket9! Sorry, long day. Is the graph circular?
Convert Ceo, Coo and Legal to a triangle. Is Lead white? Push every magenta square between Manager and Cto. Which defaults are active?
Led is beneath Vcc. Shift the orange diamond upwards, then add a caption "Back" to all of the dots. Send the triangle backwards, and tie C2 to the new gold rhombus with a dotted rose arrow.
Let me see. Make a minuscule navy ellipse with the name Cedar, labeled "Input" in the center of the page. That's the main flow. Rename the latest one to Lumen!
Join Bathroom to Lounge, Bedroom and Pantry with a line labeled "ok?", and plonk a hexagon. It was getting crowded. Move the hexagon 5 px left.
Is there a path from Users to Budget? Undo 3 times!
Cancel the rules, and place Swamp between Shrine and Dungeon. Sorry, long day. Shift it to the right. Thanks!
Wipe all of the indigo ellipses! This is for the meeting. Count the squares? Join Finance to Cto with a two headed arrow.
I'm explaining this to my team later. Give all hexagons the colour cyan, and then turn everything into a box. Colour all squares which are not brown grey.
Make the green ones an amber rectangle. After that, colour all the brown ones blue. Is there a route from the red oval to Otter?
Insert a star with the name Tundra, and after that zap the navy ones! Is Hub close to Port? Wire Dock to Factory, and Factory to Customs. Thanks.
What's written on the aqua square? Link it to Yeast.
Park the new brown ball left, and then rename this one to Willow. Tuck the new square on top of the triangle, and relocate C2 and R1 250 px upwards.
Spread Sprint2 and Task7 evenly in a row, and after that set the dot to gold.
This is for tomorrow's review. How many shapes are there? Disregard the defaults.
This is for tomorrow's review. Which one is farthest from Footer? Rename Card Willow!
Shrink the circle, and after that kill all the squares that are not blue. What is the furthest square from Sink?
Morph Villain, Climax and Twist into a star. I keep losing track of things. Scene3 is at the top edge!
Legal just above Ops. Grow the most recent hexagon a bit! Right, that's better. Recruiting is a black square.
Enlarge the earliest lime hexagon. This is for the meeting. Push it 40 px down, and after that nudge the same one right.
Spawn a rectangle along the right edge. Also, join Fish to the newest star. Organize the lime stars in a column. Next, make a copy of Coral!
3 purple ellipses in the top left corner! Wire Launch and Timeline to Risks with an arrow, and then scoot Timeline and Pricing to the left.
Reshape black balls into a rectangle! How many boxes are there? Copy Crab.
Are there any cycles? Space the ovals out vertical. Is there anything between Ceo and Recruiting?
Layout the purple stars horizontally! Is the latest indigo star giant?
